article.substack_body_markdown:
EIA reports: PJM peaked at 162.6 gigawatts (GW) on July 2, 2026, 1.3% higher than the pre-2026 peak of 160.6 GW on June 23, 2025. The Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) peaked at 91.1 GW on July 22, 2026, 6.5% higher than the pre-2026 record of 85.5 GW on August 20, 2024. The Southwest Power Pool (SWPP) peaked at 58.0 GW on July 27, 2026, 3.5% higher than the pre-2026 peak of 56.0 GW on August 21, 2023. [[SOURCE:SOURCE_1]]

EIA's qualification: Data from Form EIA-930 is reported to us by each balancing authority (BA) and is made available "as-is". [[SOURCE:SOURCE_1]]

Separate context from EIA: We estimate that U.S. generation from small-scale or rooftop solar photovoltaic systems (smaller than 1 megawatt of capacity) has increased from 18,812 gigawatthours (GWh) to 92,979 GWh over the last decade. [[SOURCE:SOURCE_2]]

BLS: Consumer Price Index increased in September. What the dated evidence can and cannot tell us.

The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U) increased 0.6 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in September after rising 0.4 percent in August, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today. Over the last 12 months, the all items index increased 3.7 percent before seasonal adjustment.

headlines.headline_text: Capital Chronicle report update: Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, 15 October 2026; week ending 9 October. Commercial crude inventories fell 8.6 million barrels to 415.6 million, while imports fell 791,000 barrels per day. Gasoline stocks rose 3.5 million barrels; distillate stocks fell 2.5 million. These are original EIA balance data retained on 18 October, not a release-time surprise estimate.

We estimate that U.S. generation from small-scale or rooftop solar photovoltaic systems (smaller than 1 megawatt of capacity) has increased from 18,812 gigawatthours (GWh) to 92,979 GWh over the last decade.

PJM peaked at 162.6 gigawatts (GW) on July 2, 2026, 1.3% higher than the pre-2026 peak of 160.6 GW on June 23, 2025. The Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) peaked at 91.1 GW on July 22, 2026, 6.5% higher than the pre-2026 record of 85.5 GW on August 20, 2024. The Southwest Power Pool (SWPP) peaked at 58.0 GW on July 27, 2026, 3.5% higher than the pre-2026 peak of 56.0 GW on August 21, 2023.

The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U) increased 0.6 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in September after rising 0.4 percent in August, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today. Over the last 12 months, the all items index increased 3.7 percent before seasonal adjustment.

headlines.headline_text: Capital Chronicle report update: Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, 15 October 2026; week ending 9 October. Commercial crude inventories fell 8.6 million barrels to 415.6 million, while imports fell 791,000 barrels per day. Gasoline stocks rose 3.5 million barrels; distillate stocks fell 2.5 million. These are original EIA balance data retained on 18 October, not a release-time surprise estimate.

We estimate that U.S. generation from small-scale or rooftop solar photovoltaic systems (smaller than 1 megawatt of capacity) has increased from 18,812 gigawatthours (GWh) to 92,979 GWh over the last decade.

PJM peaked at 162.6 gigawatts (GW) on July 2, 2026, 1.3% higher than the pre-2026 peak of 160.6 GW on June 23, 2025. The Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) peaked at 91.1 GW on July 22, 2026, 6.5% higher than the pre-2026 record of 85.5 GW on August 20, 2024. The Southwest Power Pool (SWPP) peaked at 58.0 GW on July 27, 2026, 3.5% higher than the pre-2026 peak of 56.0 GW on August 21, 2023.

The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U) increased 0.6 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in September after rising 0.4 percent in August, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today. Over the last 12 months, the all items index increased 3.7 percent before seasonal adjustment.

headlines.headline_text: Capital Chronicle report update: Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, 15 October 2026; week ending 9 October. Commercial crude inventories fell 8.6 million barrels to 415.6 million, while imports fell 791,000 barrels per day. Gasoline stocks rose 3.5 million barrels; distillate stocks fell 2.5 million. These are original EIA balance data retained on 18 October, not a release-time surprise estimate.

We estimate that U.S. generation from small-scale or rooftop solar photovoltaic systems (smaller than 1 megawatt of capacity) has increased from 18,812 gigawatthours (GWh) to 92,979 GWh over the last decade.

PJM peaked at 162.6 gigawatts (GW) on July 2, 2026, 1.3% higher than the pre-2026 peak of 160.6 GW on June 23, 2025. The Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) peaked at 91.1 GW on July 22, 2026, 6.5% higher than the pre-2026 record of 85.5 GW on August 20, 2024. The Southwest Power Pool (SWPP) peaked at 58.0 GW on July 27, 2026, 3.5% higher than the pre-2026 peak of 56.0 GW on August 21, 2023.

The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U) increased 0.6 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in September after rising 0.4 percent in August, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today. Over the last 12 months, the all items index increased 3.7 percent before seasonal adjustment.

Underlying evidence does not establish executable CFD economics.

Underlying evidence does not establish executable CFD economics.

Underlying evidence does not establish executable CFD economics.

CONDITIONAL_SCENARIO: Winter heating demand, supply response and export demand determine the inventory draw path; an October stock surplus can coexist with winter tightness, but the curve and CFD financing/roll are missing. Underlying evidence does not establish executable CFD economics.

claim_lineage.claim_text: EIA release 2026-10-15: the weekly injection was 67 Bcf for the week ended 2026-10-09, versus the five-year same-week injection average of 90 Bcf. The stock level was 3567 Bcf, 45 Bcf above the five-year stock average and 143 Bcf below the prior-year stock level.

report_claims.basis_risk: Underlying evidence does not establish executable CFD economics.

evidence.source_identity: U.S. EIA Form EIA-912 / Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report Supplement

claim_lineage.claim_text: Capital Chronicle analysis: the smaller seasonal refill tightens the weekly balance at the margin, while the above-average stock cushion limits a simple shortage interpretation. It does not measure a market surprise or predict the CFD price.

report_claims.basis_risk: Underlying evidence does not establish executable CFD economics.

evidence.source_identity: U.S. EIA Form EIA-912 / Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report Supplement

claim_lineage.claim_text: The next weekly EIA release can test whether the small refill persisted; weather and a pre-release consensus are required to distinguish seasonality from a tradable surprise. If independent balance evidence confirms tightening, upward pressure is possible; warmer weather or supply recovery can reverse it. No price target or probability is estimated.

report_claims.basis_risk: Underlying evidence does not establish executable CFD economics.

evidence.source_identity: U.S. EIA Form EIA-912 / Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report Supplement

claim_lineage.claim_text: Several weekly storage releases and weather-normalized balances must show the cushion narrowing; one small refill cannot establish a sustained deficit through the shoulder season. If independent balance evidence confirms tightening, upward pressure is possible; warmer weather or supply recovery can reverse it. No price target or probability is estimated.

report_claims.basis_risk: Underlying evidence does not establish executable CFD economics.

evidence.source_identity: U.S. EIA Form EIA-912 / Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report Supplement

claim_lineage.claim_text: Winter heating demand, supply response and export demand determine the inventory draw path; an October stock surplus can coexist with winter tightness, but the curve and CFD financing/roll are missing. If independent balance evidence confirms tightening, upward pressure is possible; warmer weather or supply recovery can reverse it. No price target or probability is estimated.

report_claims.basis_risk: Underlying evidence does not establish executable CFD economics.

evidence.source_identity: U.S. EIA Form EIA-912 / Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report Supplement

claim_lineage.claim_text: Retain the analytical tightening watch only while subsequent storage and weather-normalized balance evidence supports it; this is not an instruction to hold a position.

report_claims.basis_risk: Underlying evidence does not establish executable CFD economics.

evidence.source_identity: U.S. EIA Form EIA-912 / Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report Supplement

claim_lineage.claim_text: Invalidate the tightening watch if seasonal refills recover and the storage cushion widens, or required evidence remains unavailable at the next review.

report_claims.basis_risk: Underlying evidence does not establish executable CFD economics.

evidence.source_identity: U.S. EIA Form EIA-912 / Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report Supplement
